correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge3\) the only directed cycle is the full coherent rim; each pendant conflicts with exactly one rim arc and no other pendant. The resulting factorization proves the face polynomial. Uniform pendants produce a crosspolytope boundary with one facet deleted (a ball). Every mixed cyclic binary word has an inward-to-outward transition, yielding an unconstrained rim arc. Toggling it in descending-cardinality free-face pairs collapses every pendant-bearing simplex onto the rim boundary, proving the integral homotopy type and canonical inclusion. Rotation character is the sign of the induced rim permutation. Direct exhaustive face/collapse/mod-two checks for n=3,4,5,6 corroborate all finite instances but are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete simple-homotopy classification of all \(2^n\) orientations of a canonical cycle-with-one-pendant-per-vertex family, with a sharp orientation-dependent change from a PL ball to a sphere. The canonical inclusion identifies exactly when the core cycle fundamental class survives. An exact orientation-transition face polynomial gives finer enumerative information and the rotation sign specifies symmetry on surviving homology. The structural free-rim-edge collapse supplies a reusable method; the result is not presented as a general theorem about all cycles with arbitrary attachments.
